category_edits.rationale: Test a modest increase from width 48 to 52 across all four category models. Existing dimension-dependent layers, checkpoint metadata and the embedded predictor propagate this width consistently while preserving tied embeddings, causal topology, scoring, loss and optimizer.

response.change_summary: Increase tied item-embedding and matching hidden width to 52, retaining one NextItNet checkpoint per category and metadata-driven predictor compatibility.
